description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractConsumer' that provides a base implementation for message consumers in a client communicating with a Hono server. It includes methods for managing message flow, credits, and connection closing logic.

classes.name: AbstractConsumer
classes.description: An abstract class that implements the MessageConsumer interface, providing common functionality for consuming messages from a Hono server, including credit management and connection closing.

methods.name: setLocalCloseHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler invoked after the consumer has been closed locally.

methods.name: getRemainingCredit
methods.description: Calculates and returns the amount of remaining message credit.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Requests more message credits from the receiver.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the consumer and its links, and invokes handlers upon completion.
